text_en: And the people of Kiriath-jearim came and took up the ark of the Lord , and brought it to the house of Abinadab on the hill. They consecrated his son, Eleazar, to have charge of the ark of the Lord .
text_cn: 克黎雅特耶阿陵人遂下来，将上主的约柜抬上去，送到住在丘岭上的阿彼纳达布家里，并且祝圣他的儿子厄肋阿匝尔，看守上主的约柜。

text_en: From the day that the ark was lodged at Kiriath-jearim, a long time passed, some twenty years, and all the house of Israel lamented after the Lord .
text_cn: 自从约柜停放在克黎雅特耶阿陵的那天起，过了很长的时间，大约二十年之久，以色列全家又归向上主。

text_en: Then Samuel said to all the house of Israel, “If you are returning to the Lord with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Astartes from among you. Direct your heart to the Lord , and serve him only, and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines. ”
text_cn: 那时撒慕尔对以色列全家说：“如果你们全心归向上主，就该将外邦的神由你们中间铲除，一心归向上主，惟独事奉上主，他必由培肋舍特人手中解救你们。”

text_en: So Israel put away the Baals and the Astartes, and they served the Lord only.
text_cn: 以色列子民遂铲除了巴耳和阿市托勒特，唯独事奉上主。

text_en: Then Samuel said, “Gather all Israel at Mizpah, and I will pray to the Lord for you. ”
text_cn: 于是撒慕尔说：“你们把全以色列聚集在米兹帕，我要为你们恳求上主。”

text_en: So they gathered at Mizpah, and drew water and poured it out before the Lord . They fasted that day, and said, “We have sinned against the Lord . ” And Samuel judged the people of Israel at Mizpah.
text_cn: 他们便聚集在米兹帕，汲了水来，倒在上主面前，并且在那一天禁食说：“我们犯了罪，得罪了上主！”从此撒慕尔在米兹帕治理以色列子民。

text_en: When the Philistines heard that the people of Israel had gathered at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the people of Israel heard of it they were afraid of the Philistines.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人一听说以色列子民聚集在米兹帕，培肋舍特的酋长就上来攻打以色列，以色列子民听说培肋舍特人前来，大为震惊，

text_en: The people of Israel said to Samuel, “Do not cease to cry out to the Lord our God for us, and pray that he may save us from the hand of the Philistines. ”
text_cn: 对撒慕尔说：“你不要停止为我们哀求上主，我们的天主，好叫他救我们脱离培肋舍特人的威胁。”

text_en: So Samuel took a sucking lamb and offered it as a whole burnt offering to the Lord ; Samuel cried out to the Lord for Israel, and the Lord answered him.
text_cn: 撒慕尔遂拿了一只还在吃奶的羔羊献给上主，作全燔祭，为以色列呼吁上主，上主应允了他。

text_en: As Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to attack Israel; but the Lord thundered with a mighty voice that day against the Philistines and threw them into confusion; and they were routed before Israel.
text_cn: 当撒慕尔正在奉献全燔祭时，培肋舍特人前来，要与以色列交战；但上主在那一天使雷声向着培肋舍特人大作，恐吓他们，他们就在以色列面前溃退了。

text_en: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, and struck them down as far as beyond Beth-car.
text_cn: 以色列人遂从米兹帕出来追击培肋舍特人，击杀他们直到贝特加尔下边。

text_en: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Jeshanah, and named it Ebenezer; for he said, “Thus far the Lord has helped us. ”
text_cn: 以后，撒慕尔取了一块石头，竖立在米兹帕与耶撒纳中间，给那石起名叫厄本厄则尔，说：“直到这时上主救助了我们。”

text_en: So the Philistines were subdued and did not again enter the territory of Israel; the hand of the Lord was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人受了这次挫折以后，不敢再来侵犯以色列的边境；撒慕尔活着时，上主的手常压制了培肋舍特人。

text_en: The towns that the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron to Gath; and Israel recovered their territory from the hand of the Philistines. There was peace also between Israel and the Amorites.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人由以色列夺去的城市，自厄刻龙直到加特，都归还了以色列；以色列人由培肋舍特人手中收复了自己的领土；在那时以色列和阿摩黎人之间平安无事。

text_en: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
text_cn: 撒慕尔一生做了以色列的民长。

text_en: He went on a circuit year by year to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all these places.
text_cn: 他每年去视察贝特耳、基耳加耳和米兹帕，在这些地方治理以色列人。

text_en: Then he would come back to Ramah, for his home was there; he administered justice there to Israel, and built there an altar to the Lord .
text_cn: 以后他回到辣玛，因为他的家在那里，他也在那里治理以色列人，并在那里给上主建了一座祭坛。
